shared: Snake actors whose deaths are acts: each death fires its effect, and the body usually gets back up.
differ: How deaths pay off: as stats next turn, in a full-Health cast comeback, or doubled by seating.

takes.label: Die again and again
takes.line: Units fake-die again and again each fight, getting straight back up; next turn, those fake deaths pay out as permanent stats.
takes.look_if: units that die several times a fight and cash it next turn.

takes.label: The second act
takes.line: Downed units lie limp and untouchable; when the whole cast is down, all stand up at full Health, keeping their gains.
takes.look_if: a comeback built into every unit, not one late card.

takes.label: Who stands behind whom
takes.line: Death effects double only for units in front of one card, and a never-spent tally counts every death, any tribe's, all game.
takes.look_if: death effects doubled by where units sit, plus a game-long tally.
